articles.title: Sergio Donnelly, 87, Bus Driver
articles.deck: Friends remember Sergio Donnelly for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate.

Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Sergio Donnelly spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Sergio Donnelly died in October at home on Eastgate Avenue, at the age of 87.
